data.headline: Audio Director | Games and Interactive | AI Voice & Generative Audio | Immersive VR/XR Audio | Peabody, Emmy and AIAS Award Winner | ex Epic Games x Disney collabs, Epic Games Special Projects, Meta, EA
data.about: Audio Director and creative content leader with 30+ years shaping sound for AAA games, VR/XR, and emerging platforms.  I've led large-scale, cross-disciplinary audio teams at Epic Games, Meta, and EA — delivering award-winning work across Unreal Engine (UE5/UEFN) and Frostbite. My credits include landmark interactive experiences reaching tens of millions of players globally, from Fortnite chapter events to Emmy- and Peabody-winning VR narratives.  Specialties: ▸ AI Voice R&D — voice synthesis, voice cloning, automated voice quality evaluation, neural TTS pipelines (including the Fortnite AI Darth Vader character voice model) ▸ Audio direction — creative and technical leadership for AAA franchises (Epic x Disney collaborations, Battlefield, The Simpsons, Lord of the Rings, James Bond) ▸ VR/XR audio — spatial audio, binaural, immersive narrative, Oculus/Meta Quest ▸ Music — composition, supervision, licensing, adaptive/interactive music systems ▸ Sound Design - linear and interactive AAA sound design▸ Mix - linear and interactive mix▸ Voiceover — casting, directing, script supervision, motion capture audio ▸ Leadership — staffing, mentorship, budgeting, scheduling, vendor managementAwards: Peabody (Wolves in the Walls) · Emmy (Wolves in the Walls) · AIAS Sound Design of the Year (LOTR Return of the King) Open to: Audio Director, Head of Audio, Audio Manager, Audio Producer, VP of Audio, AI Voice Lead, AI Voice Manager, VR/XR Audio Director, Principal Sound Designer roles.
